tool_input.command:
cd /app && python3 -m pip install pytube --quiet 2>&1 && python3 << 'EOF'
from pytube import YouTube
import os

try:
    yt = YouTube('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCbvyPbhRfA')
    stream = yt.streams.get_highest_resolution()
    if stream:
        stream.download(filename='zork_video.mp4')
        print('Downloaded successfully')
    else:
        print('No stream found')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
EOF

cd /app && source venv/bin/activate && timeout 900 python3 << 'EOFWHISPER'
import whisper
import json

# Load tiny model for speed on CPU
model = whisper.load_model("tiny")

# Transcribe the video
result = model.transcribe("zork_video.mp4", verbose=False, language="en")

# Write full transcript
with open("transcript.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(result["text"])

# Write segments
with open("transcript_segments.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(result["segments"], f, indent=2)

print("Transcription complete")
print(f"Full text length: {len(result['text'])} chars")
print(f"Number of segments: {len(result['segments'])}")
EOFWHISPER
